description: One privilege, two spellings on adjacent reference pages that both send the reader to Authorization for the same thing: join.md writes it as `query_select` in code style, insert.md as _Query Select_ in italic title case. Extraction keyed on the rendered string sees two terms. Sharpened in round 12: both spellings name a ROLE, not a privilege - roles.md documents 'Role: Query Select (query_select)'. So the pages disagree on capitalisation and code style AND both mislabel the tier. See server-rbac-privilege-tier-is-abstract-only.
